verdicts.summary: [L] states no counterpart of what [M] prints. [M] prints `\mathcal T_m^a(K+\lambda(H-K)) =\mathcal T_m^a(K)+\lambda(\mathcal T_m^a(H)-\mathcal T_m^a(K))`.
evidence: [M] (proof of Lemma 13.18) prints the affine identity T_m^a(K+lambda(H-K)) = T_m^a(K)+lambda(T_m^a(H)-T_m^a(K)) for the normalized degree-a kernel coefficient map, and uses it with the extrapolated input K_* to get the 1/4 contraction across cutoffs. [L]'s cutoff argument (Camp.mist via Camp.purchase) gets its contraction from the Lipschitz field of the Cart structure, Seal.amounts: `‖H x-H y‖ ≤ R*‖x-y‖` on Grip, which is assumed, not derived from any affineness; no declaration in Camp or elsewhere in [L] states an affine/linear identity for a kernel-extraction map in its incoming kernel. The IsLinearMap facts in UVExtension (Gale/Mare, Lacing/Veranda, Swell/Moor, Fallow/Fife) concern other maps, so the claim stands; it is not a typo.

[M] prints T_m^a(K+lambda(H-K)) = T_m^a(K)+lambda(T_m^a(H)-T_m^a(K)) for the normalized coefficient map of the cubic, quartic and quadratic-loop kernels, and uses it for the extrapolation step giving the 1/4 contraction. [L]'s Camp.viva only turns uniformly bounded holomorphic maps on a ball with real-line convergence into a SummitUV limit (Montel/Vitali-type); it has no kernel-extraction map and no affine hypothesis or conclusion. No declaration in [L] states affineness of a degree extraction in its incoming kernel; the affine hits (affineInputs, Lattice.affine, Aff.*) concern polynomial substitutions, lattice isometries and Gaussian germs.
